data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Rhanzus', which means 'ruler'. In the Bible, 'Rance' is not a directly mentioned name. The name Rance carries the meaning “Ruler, Advice, Counsel” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rance usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler, advice, counsel and live with faith, good character and purpose.
